title: dryopteris cystolepidota
intro: Dryopteris cystolepidota, commonly known as the Japanese shield fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris cystolepidota include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve circulation, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenols, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
